raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #41227.

Under transformers v5 the RoPE base lives inside `rope_parameters`, and `rope_scaling` is an alias whose setter replaces that dict wholesale. `get_config()` applies `--json-model-override-args` with a plain `setattr`, so an override like

```
--json-model-override-args '{"rope_scaling": {"rope_type": "llama3", "factor": 32.0, ...}}'
```

(even one that just restates the checkpoint's own scaling) leaves `rope_parameters` without `rope_theta`. `get_rope_config()` then silently falls back to 10000 and the model keeps generating fluent text with the wrong base; the issue measured Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct GSM8K (first 200) dropping from 161 to 106. Models with a hard-coded per-model fallback (Qwen3 dense, 1e6) hide the problem; Llama (500000) and Qwen3-MoE do not.

An earlier attempt (#41239) was closed by its author before review.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/utils/hf_transformers/config.py`: when the override key is `rope_scaling` or `rope_parameters` and both the override and the loaded value are dicts, merge them (override keys win, the rest survives) instead of replacing the dict. Other override keys are untouched; nested `PretrainedConfig` overrides keep the existing `update()` path.

## Accuracy Tests

No model code changes. Two cases in `test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers_loading.py`, using a local Llama `config.json` with `rope_theta: 500000` (no weights, no download):

- restating the checkpoint's llama3 scaling with a new `factor` through either `rope_scaling` or `rope_parameters` keeps `rope_theta == 500000` and applies the factor;
- an override that names `rope_theta` still wins, while the other rope keys survive.

On `main` both fail (`AssertionError: 10000 != 500000.0`, then `KeyError: 'factor'`); with the fix they pass and the whole file passes (6 tests, 4 subtests; Python 3.12, CPU).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: config loading only.

### Upstream

The root cause is the `rope_scaling` property setter in transformers (`configuration_utils.py`), which replaces `rope_parameters` wholesale; huggingface/transformers#49515 proposes fixing it there. SGLang still needs this merge for the transformers releases it supports today (up to 5.19.0 at the time of this PR).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
Thanks for checking the recipes. Confirmed on `main`: the Qwen3-Next 1M-context commands pass `{"rope_scaling": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 4.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144}}` with no `rope_theta`, which is exactly the case `test_rope_scaling_override_keeps_the_rope_base` covers (the base silently falls back to the default). The Ling-2.6 / Ling-3.0 snippets spell out `rope_theta` and `partial_rotary_factor` inside the override, so they survive either way; with this merge both styles give the same result.

The root cause in the transformers setter is proposed upstream in huggingface/transformers#49515; this PR keeps the override correct on the transformers releases SGLang pins today.

sgl cookbook recipes (Qwen3-Next 1M context, Ling-2.6/Ling-3.0 YaRN) instruct users to launch with --json-model-override-args '{"rope_scaling": ...}', so the silent rope_theta → `10000` drop hits officially documented usage on the pinned transformers v5, and the merge semantics here look correct.

files.patch:
@@ -384,6 +384,14 @@ def get_config(
             current = getattr(config, key, None)
             if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(current, PretrainedConfig):
                 current.update(value)
+            elif (
+                key in ("rope_scaling", "rope_parameters")
+                and isinstance(value, dict)
+                and isinstance(current, dict)
+            ):
+                # v5's rope_scaling setter replaces rope_parameters wholesale;
+                # merge so partial overrides keep rope_theta (#41227).
+                setattr(config, key, {**current, **value})
             else:
                 setattr(config, key, value)

@@ -129,6 +129,55 @@ def test_nested_config_override_preserves_text_config(self):
         self.assertEqual(get_context_length(text), 1024)
         self.assertEqual(config.vision_config.patch_size, 14)
 
+    def llama3_rope_config(self):
+        config = self.text_config()
+        config["rope_parameters"] = {
+            "rope_type": "llama3",
+            "rope_theta": 500000.0,
+            "factor": 8.0,
+            "low_freq_factor": 1.0,
+            "high_freq_factor": 4.0,
+            "original_max_position_embeddings": 128,
+        }
+        return config
+
+    def test_rope_scaling_override_merges_with_checkpoint(self):
+        # Regression for #41227: v5's rope_scaling setter replaces
+        # rope_parameters wholesale, dropping an unmentioned rope_theta.
+        self.write_config(self.llama3_rope_config())
+        restated = {
+            "rope_type": "llama3",
+            "factor": 32.0,
+            "low_freq_factor": 1.0,
+            "high_freq_factor": 4.0,
+            "original_max_position_embeddings": 128,
+        }
+
+        for key in ("rope_scaling", "rope_parameters"):
+            with self.subTest(key=key):
+                config = get_config(
+                    self.model_path,
+                    trust_remote_code=False,
+                    local_files_only=True,
+                    model_override_args={key: restated},
+                )
+                theta, rope = get_rope_config(get_hf_text_config(config))
+
+                self.assertEqual(theta, 500000.0)
+                self.assertEqual(rope["factor"], 32.0)
+                self.assertEqual(rope["rope_type"], "llama3")
+
+        config = get_config(
+            self.model_path,
+            trust_remote_code=False,
+            local_files_only=True,
+            model_override_args={"rope_scaling": {"rope_theta": 1000000.0}},
+        )
+        theta, rope = get_rope_config(get_hf_text_config(config))
+
+        self.assertEqual(theta, 1000000.0)
+        self.assertEqual(rope["factor"], 8.0)
+
     def test_tokenizer_loading_preserves_batch_special_tokens_and_chat(self):
         self.write_config(self.text_config())
         self.make_tokenizer().save_pretrained(self.model_path)
